_comment: Carried over from 05293190AC by tools/port.py; do not edit by hand, edit the reference annotations and re-run.

EquipmentFlags.5: automatic transmission: set at reset with Options0324 bit 1, or by CcdReceive when the transmission module is seen on the bus
EquipmentFlags.3: copy of Options0335 bit 1 (leak detection pump fitted) at reset
EquipmentFlags.2: power steering pressure switch fitted (EquipmentDetect, PspPresentCounter)
EquipmentFlags.1: copy of Options032C bit 0 at reset
EquipmentFlags.0: copy of Options0329 bit 2 (catalyst temperature sensor) at reset

Options0323.7: engine/ignition variant (SparkEventCalc, StartInjectorPulse, KnockSample, GptRegisterCheck, SciSendByte)
Options0323.6: engine variant: selects the per-cylinder table ($4678 or $4684) in MisfireSegmentTime and a branch in Isr_GPT_IC1
Options0323.1: ignition output variant (OutputTestOcFire, CamCrankMeasure, CalcEngineRpm, Reset)
Options0323.2: ignition output variant (OutputTestOcFire, CamCrankMeasure, CalcEngineRpm, Reset)
Options0323.3: ignition output variant (OutputTestOcFire, CamCrankMeasure, CalcEngineRpm, Reset)

Options0324.7: event layout variant: segment times, fuel accounting, spark events (CamCrankMeasure, CylinderBit, InjectorFuelAccount, Isr_GPT_IC2, KnockSample and others)
Options0324.5: spark/dwell variant (CalcSpark, DwellCalc, Isr_GPT_OC2, CalcEngineRpm, OcOutputsReset, Reset)
Options0324.4: calibration type: adds 4 to CalTypeCopy at reset
Options0324.3: manual transmission: the gear state, park/neutral, starter-cut and automatic-only paths are skipped (GearStateUpdate, PnSwitchMonitor, StarterCut, IdleRpmTarget and others); set in 05007038 and 05293148AA
Options0324.2: PCI bus (SAE J1850 VPW) instead of CCD: PciReceive / PciPitTick run instead of CcdReceive / CcdTransmit
Options0324.1: automatic transmission: copied to EquipmentFlags bit 5 at reset; clear in 05007038 and 05293148AA

Options0325.7: closed loop off: ClosedLoopMain clears the O2 state and the short-term trim

Options0326.7: board variant (SwitchInputsRead, SwitchBitsCollect, SciSendByte, AcClutchControl, StartInjectorPulse, Isr_GPT_IC1 and others)
Options0326.6: fan output variant (FanPwmMain, FanRelayControl, FanPwmOutputCheck, QspiOutputStatus, SwitchBitsCollect, output tests)
Options0326.5: board variant (EquipmentDetect, SwitchInputsRead, VssPulseCalc, Isr_GPT_IC3, O2CellSelect, QspiOutputStatus, output tests)
Options0326.4: board variant: switch-input map (SwitchBitsCollect), O2UpdateUpstream, SciSendByte, QspiOutputStatus

Options0329.7: upstream O2 sensor 1 fitted (ClosedLoopManager, FuelSysTooRich1Monitor, FuelSysTooLean1Monitor, O2HeaterMonitor, O2HighVoltMonitor)
Options0329.3: selects branches in the fuel event, closed-loop timing, idle and flex code
Options0329.2: catalyst temperature sensor fitted (CatTempMonitor, ProcessCoolantTemp); copied to EquipmentFlags bit 0 at reset

Options032A.4: fuel level from the bus instead of the sender, probably
Options032A.3: battery temperature sensor check variant (both branches exist in BatteryTempSensorCheck)
Options032A.2: battery temperature sensor check variant (both branches exist in BatteryTempSensorCheck)
Options032A.0: battery temperature model on (BattTempModelOn); PciReceive also reads it
Options032A.6: knock sensor variant (knock sample, retard, learn and spark code)
Options032A.7: knock sensor variant (knock sample, retard, learn and spark code)

Options032B.7: A/C pressure sensor fitted, not a switch (AcPressureSensor): idle A/C steps, clutch, cut and fan

Options032C.0: copied to EquipmentFlags bit 1 at reset

Options032D.4: PWM fan output (FanMain, FanPwmOutputCheck, Reset; also output tests and PurgeFlowTest)

Options032E.7: per-event spark on (EventSparkOn); also the cam signal handling (Isr_GPT_IC4OC5, CamSignalCheck)
Options032E.2: part-throttle fuel: MAP is held at the first x point of PartThrottleMapScale as a minimum (CalcFuelPulse)
Options032E.1: security variant: the security timeout is stored and reported (SecurityTimeoutStore, CcdA4StatusBytes)

Options032F.1: alternative field control: ChargeControl2 instead of ChargeControl in the PIT code (FieldControlAlt)

Options0330.3: alternative purge duty table off closed throttle (PurgeRampControl)
Options0330.2: alternative purge duty table at closed throttle (PurgeRampControl)

Options0331.7: idle flare check off (IdleFlareCheck skips when set)
Options0331.4: development port on: external 16 KB device on chip select 1 at $20000, probably the dual-port RAM of a calibration tool (DevPortInit, DevPortService, DevPortChannel1-8; FinishFuelPulse, StartInjectorPulse and SparkEventCalc write per-event values to it); clear in 05007038 and 05293148AA
Options0331.0: start injector / spark variant (StartInjectorPulse, FinishFuelPulse, SparkEventCalc)

Options0332.2: speed control switch variant; also used by EquipmentDetect
Options0332.0: speed control switch preset at reset (sets SwitchInputs2 bit 4 with VacLeakFlags bit 2)
Options0332.5: speed control switch variant; also used by EquipmentDetect
Options0332.6: speed control switch variant; also used by EquipmentDetect

Options0335.7: O2 response monitor, sensor 1 (P0133) on: ObdMonitorOptionBits row 2; also readiness (ObdReadiness)
Options0335.6: O2 response monitor, sensor 2 (P0153) on: ObdMonitorOptionBits row 3; also readiness (ObdReadiness)
Options0335.5: purge flow test on (PurgeFlowTest); set in 05007038, clear in 05293148AA
Options0335.4: catalyst monitor bank 1 (P0420) on: ObdMonitorOptionBits row 0; also readiness (ObdReadiness)
Options0335.3: catalyst monitor bank 2 (P0432) on: ObdMonitorOptionBits row 1; also readiness (ObdReadiness)
Options0335.1: leak detection pump fitted (LDP monitor and tests); copied to EquipmentFlags bit 3 at reset; set in 05007038, clear in 05293148AA

Options0336.7: heater monitor for O2 sensor 1 supported (O2HeaterMonitor)
Options0336.6: heater monitor for O2 sensor 2 supported
Options0336.5: heater monitor for O2 sensor 3 (downstream 1) supported
Options0336.4: heater monitor for O2 sensor 4 (downstream 2) supported
Options0336.3: fuel system monitors (P0171/P0172/P0174/P0175) on: ObdMonitorOptionBits rows 11-14

Options0338.5: brake switch, VSS and purge flow monitors variant
Options0338.1: brake switch, VSS and purge flow monitors variant
